# The package a sql: import writes, run against SQLite on every target that
# queries one: the interpreter, each Go platform, and android under
# Robolectric through the platform's own SQLiteDatabase.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout '8 tests, 0 failures'
! stderr .

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout '8 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout '8 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout '8 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout '8 tests, 0 failures'

# A target that writes no statement skips the tests, naming why.
sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout 'the program queries a database, which html/none cannot yet'

-- app.sngl --
// Every kind of query, a value of every column type written and read back, a
// failure classified, a trigger the schema's statements kept whole, and the
// component over a read. Each test opens a database of its own.

import async "sngl:async"
import books "sql:./db/queries.sql"
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

func add(title string, pages option[int64] = null) int64 {
    match var id = books.addBookCall(title=title, pages=pages, rating=4.5, lent=false, added=null, due=null) {
        ok { return id }
        failed { return -1 }
    }
}

func testRoundTrip(t test.Test) {
    t.setContext(books.source, ":memory:roundTrip")
    t.assert(books.create().ok == 4)
    match var id = books.addBookCall(title="Earthsea", pages=264, rating=4.5, lent=true, added="2024-03-01T10:30:00Z", due="2024-04-01") {
        ok { t.assert(id == 1) }
        failed { t.assert(id.message == "") }
    }
    match var b = books.getBookCall(id=1) {
        ok {
            t.assert(b.id == 1)
            t.assert(b.title == "Earthsea")
            t.assert(b.pages == 264)
            t.assert(b.rating == 4.5)
            t.assert(b.lent)
            t.assert(b.added != null && "{b.added}" == "2024-03-01T10:30:00Z")
            t.assert(b.due != null && "{b.due}" == "2024-04-01")
        }
        failed { t.assert(b.message == "") }
    }
}

func testNulls(t test.Test) {
    t.setContext(books.source, ":memory:nulls")
    t.assert(books.create().ok == 4)
    var id = add("Tehanu")
    match var b = books.getBookCall(id=id) {
        ok {
            t.assert(b.pages == null)
            t.assert(b.added == null)
            t.assert(b.due == null)
            t.assert(!b.lent)
        }
        failed { t.assert(b.message == "") }
    }
}

func testMissing(t test.Test) {
    t.setContext(books.source, ":memory:missing")
    t.assert(books.create().ok == 4)
    match var b = books.getBookCall(id=99) {
        ok { t.assert(false) }
        failed {
            t.assert(b.kind == async.FailureKind.request)
            t.assert(b.code == "02000")
        }
    }
}

func testMany(t test.Test) {
    t.setContext(books.source, ":memory:many")
    t.assert(books.create().ok == 4)
    add("The Farthest Shore")
    add("A Wizard of Earthsea")
    add("Tales")
    match var found = books.findBooksCall(pattern="%Earth%") {
        ok {
            t.assert(found.length() == 1)
            t.assert(found[0].title == "A Wizard of Earthsea")
        }
        failed { t.assert(found.message == "") }
    }
    match var n = books.countBooksCall() {
        ok { t.assert(n == 3) }
        failed { t.assert(n.message == "") }
    }
    match var titles = books.titlesCall() {
        ok { t.assert(titles == ["A Wizard of Earthsea", "Tales", "The Farthest Shore"]) }
        failed { t.assert(titles.message == "") }
    }
}

func testExec(t test.Test) {
    t.setContext(books.source, ":memory:exec")
    t.assert(books.create().ok == 4)
    var id = add("Tehanu", 252)
    match var n = books.lendBookCall(lent=true, id=id) {
        ok { t.assert(n == 1) }
        failed { t.assert(n.message == "") }
    }
    match var n = books.lendBookCall(lent=true, id=99) {
        ok { t.assert(n == 0) }
        failed { t.assert(n.message == "") }
    }
    match var done = books.removeBookCall(id=id) {
        ok { t.assert(done.rows == 1) }
        failed { t.assert(done.message == "") }
    }
    match var b = books.getBookCall(id=id) {
        ok { t.assert(false) }
        failed { t.assert(b.code == "02000") }
    }
}

func testConstraint(t test.Test) {
    t.setContext(books.source, ":memory:constraint")
    t.assert(books.create().ok == 4)
    add("Tehanu")
    match var id = books.addBookCall(title="Tehanu", pages=null, rating=0.0, lent=false, added=null, due=null) {
        ok { t.assert(false) }
        failed {
            t.assert(id.kind == async.FailureKind.request)
            t.assert(id.code == "SQLITE_CONSTRAINT")
        }
    }
}

// The trigger's body holds statements of its own: the schema is split by
// SQLite's own parser, not at each semicolon.
func testTrigger(t test.Test) {
    t.setContext(books.source, ":memory:trigger")
    t.assert(books.create().ok == 4)
    var id = add("Tehanu")
    match var what = books.loggedCall(book=id) {
        ok { t.assert(what == ["added"]) }
        failed { t.assert(what.message == "") }
    }
}

component shelf ui.node {
    var pattern = "%Wizard%"
    var found option[list[books.FindBooksRow]] = null
    var ready = false
    books.source(":memory:shelf") {
        if ready {
            books.findBooks(pattern=pattern, :value=found)
        }
    }
    ui.text #title(value=found != null && found.length() > 0 ? found[0].title : "-")
    ui.button #fill(text="Fill", @click {
        books.source(":memory:shelf") {
            books.create()
            books.addBookCall(title="A Wizard of Earthsea", pages=null, rating=0.0, lent=false, added=null, due=null)
            books.addBookCall(title="Tehanu", pages=null, rating=0.0, lent=false, added=null, due=null)
        }
        ready = true
    })
    ui.button #next(text="Next", @click { pattern = "%Teh%" })
}

func testComponent(t test.Test, c shelf) {
    c.fill.click()
    t.wait(func() => c.title.value == "A Wizard of Earthsea", 5000)
    c.next.click()
    t.wait(func() => c.title.value == "Tehanu", 5000)
}

ui.window {
    shelf
}
-- db/schema.sql --
CREATE TABLE books (
  id     INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  title  TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  pages  INTEGER,
  rating REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  lent   BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  added  DATETIME,
  due    DATE
);

CREATE TABLE log (
  book INTEGER NOT NULL,
  what TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TRIGGER books_logged AFTER INSERT ON books BEGIN
  INSERT INTO log (book, what) VALUES (new.id, 'added');
END;

CREATE INDEX log_book ON log (book);
-- db/queries.sql --
-- sngl:schema schema.sql

-- name: AddBook :execlastid
INSERT INTO books (title, pages, rating, lent, added, due) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?);

-- name: GetBook :one
SELECT * FROM books WHERE id = ?;

-- name: FindBooks :many
SELECT id, title FROM books WHERE title LIKE sqlc.arg(pattern) ORDER BY id;

-- name: CountBooks :one
SELECT count(*) FROM books;

-- name: Titles :many
SELECT title FROM books ORDER BY title;

-- name: LendBook :execrows
UPDATE books SET lent = ? WHERE id = ?;

-- name: RemoveBook :execresult
DELETE FROM books WHERE id = ?;

-- name: Logged :many
SELECT what FROM log WHERE book = ?;
